request: three sequential research rounds plus parallel assumption-unrestricted side trajectory; source-weave a promising lead; widen only if warranted
candidate_seed: Explore symbols and their relationships. Learn to predict and understand them as best you can.
purpose: Expressive persistent language/symbol environment for pretrained135M model, minimal world laws, observer judgments external. Record-first was a recommendation and may be challenged. Universal transfer remains an open idea.

phases.round1: challenge starting architecture and identify concrete carrier/scheduling/interaction alternatives
phases.round2: choose consequential gaps from round1; trace sources/rivals and turn surviving proposals into a minimal blueprint
phases.round3: cross-department adversarial verification and final synthesis of limits, decision changes and next contacts

side_method.freedom: May reject any project assumption and propose alternatives, while labeling speculative claims honestly
side_method.initial_budget: up to3 candidate mechanisms and3 relevant primary sources, plus one critical reviewer
side_method.weave: original claim and actual source result; function-level bridge; rival/countercondition; cost/access; consequence for one design choice; falsifiable contact
side_method.expansion_condition: root inspection finds a source-supported mechanism and a concrete useful design implication, reviewer identifies no fatal scope mismatch; can widen once to one adjacent field and one extra primary-source contact
side_method.meaning_of_success: warrants further research, not evidence that the method improves reasoning or the model works

constraints: Planning/source research only: no small-model inference, training, downloads of models or datasets, paid endpoints, executable world changes or old-file edits.
Read compact FRR exactly, shared prior design and this brief. Different agents/sources with ancestry overlap are not independent replication.
No subspawns; root coordinates6 peers. Edit only assigned new phase/side files.
Bounded primary-source scouting; do not force all lenses, fabricate confidence or authority, or turn proposals into model-visible behavioral rules.
All peer findings go upstream to root; send cross-review questions to assigned peers or ask root to relay; retain disagreement.
Round2/3 tasks depend on actual earlier outcomes and get separate instructions; do not pre-complete all rounds.
